en.title: Former WTO head Pascal Lamy on the EU's China choice: get a rebalance, or go protectionist
en.summary: Former WTO director general Pascal Lamy, who previously served as European trade commissioner, discusses Europe's trade tensions with China and the continent's growth challenges.

stories.title: Pacific island states are trapped in Cold War 2.0

en.title: Pacific island states are trapped in Cold War 2.0
en.summary: China conducted its first test of a submarine-launched nuclear missile in the South Pacific, drawing criticism from the US and Australia while Pacific island nations responded more cautiously.

en.title: Trump and Mamdani plan to meet in New York during US president's UN visit
en.summary: US President Donald Trump will meet New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani at Gracie Mansion during Trump's visit to the UN General Assembly to discuss issues affecting the city.

stories.title: Zelensky and Trump have agreed to meet in New York, Ukrainian president says

en.title: Zelensky and Trump have agreed to meet in New York, Ukrainian president says
en.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced he and US President Donald Trump agreed to meet in New York during the UN General Assembly for talks that could advance efforts toward resolving the war with Russia.

stories.title: Russia vows revenge for Ukraine’s election-day attacks as poll shows win for ruling party

en.title: Russia vows revenge for Ukraine's election-day attacks as poll shows win for ruling party
en.summary: Russia threatened to escalate strikes on Kyiv following Ukrainian drone attacks on Moscow during Russian parliamentary voting, which left two dead and damaged an oil refinery. Exit polls indicated the ruling United Russia party was winning the tightly controlled elections.

stories.title: Thousands march in France against ‘licence to kill’ draft law

en.title: Thousands march in France against 'licence to kill' draft law
en.summary: Thousands of people demonstrated in Paris and other French cities opposing a proposed law that would legally protect police and gendarmes who use force. The National Assembly approved the bill in July, and it awaits a Senate vote.

en.summary: A U.S. official stated on the 20th that the American military will not conduct offensive strikes against Yemen's Houthi forces.

stories.title: Germany’s Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after historic state election defeat

en.title: Germany's Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after historic state election defeat
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's party suffered its worst state election result since World War II in one region, while also losing ground in another state election. Despite the electoral setback, Merz committed to continuing economic reforms.

stories.title: UK’s Burnham congratulates Trump and Danish PM on Greenland deal

en.title: UK's Burnham congratulates Trump and Danish PM on Greenland deal
en.summary: The UK Prime Minister congratulated Denmark and the United States on reaching an agreement regarding Greenland and Arctic security. The two leaders discussed the arrangement in a Sunday phone call.

en.summary: A film and music gala featuring over 140 entertainment professionals from mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau took place in Macau, combining music and cinema across four hours for audiences.

stories.title: Italy’s Meloni plans to ban burkas, niqabs in schools and cap foreign pupils in classrooms

en.title: Italy's Meloni plans to ban burkas, niqabs in schools and cap foreign pupils in classrooms
en.summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced plans to limit the number of foreign students in classrooms and prohibit burkas and niqabs in schools. The measure would also require mandatory Italian language instruction for parents of struggling foreign pupils.

en.summary: A China CITIC Bank International executive argues that financial institutions must balance digital capabilities with human trust and cross-border expertise to succeed in the future banking landscape.

stories.title: China’s CXMT touts new chip manufacturing platform as close to ‘world’s most advanced’

en.title: China's CXMT touts new chip manufacturing platform as close to 'world's most advanced'
en.summary: Chinese memory chip manufacturer CXMT announced it has begun mass production using its new G5 technology platform, which significantly increases storage density and output per wafer compared to its previous generation, potentially narrowing the gap with leading global competitors Samsung and SK Hynix.

stories.title: Housing prices surge near new Huanggang Port as buyers eye ‘dual-city’ lifestyle

en.title: Housing prices surge near new Huanggang Port as buyers eye 'dual-city' lifestyle
en.summary: Property prices near the new Huanggang Port are rising ahead of its expected opening before year-end, as buyers seek a dual-city lifestyle between Shenzhen and Hong Kong. The border crossing will feature 24-hour operations and streamlined clearance procedures.

stories.title: Will fresh incentives give China’s housing market more than a short-lived rebound?

en.title: Will fresh incentives give China's housing market more than a short-lived rebound?
en.summary: Beijing's recent policy shift to revive China's real estate market has generated increased buyer interest in major cities. Property brokers report higher inquiry volumes and are optimistic about sales momentum, though some remain uncertain whether additional government stimulus will be needed to sustain the recovery.
